podcast.body: Delia Derbyshire created what is possibly the first 100% electronic piece of music in history for the "Doctor Who" television series. She took some basic melodies and pieces developed by Ron Grainer, another Radiophonic Workshop member, and transformed them into a fantastic, entirely electronic composition that Grainer himself reportedly did not recognize. This piece served as a musical revolution, inspiring many to explore fully electronic music, years before other pioneers emerged. "Es posiblemente la primera canción 100% electrónica de la historia."

srcs.episode: Cómo una mujer inventó la música electrónica ⧸ Delia Derbyshire

podcast.body: Delia Derbyshire is renowned for her electronic arrangement of Ron Grainer's "Doctor Who Theme." Joining the BBC Radiophonic Workshop in 1962, she transformed the original composition into an entirely electronic piece, which was heard by viewers from 1963 through 1980 and became one of the most famous pieces of sci-fi music. "Her most famous work involved taking the theme from the BBC show Dr. Who and turning it into something entirely electronic."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
